about:
Kalas Manufacturing operates from Lancaster, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 1958 as a small hardware store. The company remains a privately held family business now spanning three generations of the Witwer family, with leadership extending to include all 700 associates who share a collective purpose to improve the lives they touch.

The company manufactures copper wire and cable through a vertically integrated process that begins with copper rod drawn to customer specifications. Its capabilities include product development and engineering with 3D CAD renderings, flexible manufacturing of small variable lots with short lead times, custom packaging and line-sequencing solutions, and a proprietary inventory management system for copper cost control. The Lancaster facility houses state-of-the-art equipment for producing flexible cords (Extra Hard Service, Hard Service, SVT/SVTO) and other wire products built to UL and SAE standards.

Kalas serves automotive (TS 16949 certified), appliance, lighting, and industrial equipment manufacturers, with applications ranging from vacuum cleaners and small appliances to lighting fixtures. Its engineering team works side‑by‑side with customers in the field to develop cost‑effective solutions, and its vertical integration allows tailored offerings for niche markets across a dynamic customer portfolio.

The company differentiates itself through vertical integration that ensures material control and quality at every stage, a family‑owned culture that emphasizes associate wellness and safety (K.A.R.E. program), and environmental stewardship including recycling of all reclaimable materials, VOC‑free inks, and ISO 14001 certification. Copper management programs such as fixed pricing and prior‑period averaging further help customers navigate commodity volatility.
